veld-ps-rondo-4-2.uitleg: Four players on the sides of the square keep the ball against two defenders. One defender presses the ball carrier, the other cuts off a passing lane. Whoever loses the ball (or plays it out) swaps with the defender who won it.
veld-ps-rondo-4-2.organisatie: 10 × 10 m square. One player on each side, two defenders in bibs in the middle.
coachpunten: Outside players: stay open and move so the passing lane doesn't run through a defender
Look for the split pass through the middle when the defenders are too far apart
Defenders: work together – one presses, the other covers the most dangerous lane
veld-ps-rondo-4-2.meerSpelers: With 7 players: add a middle player (5v2). With more: a second rondo.

veld-ps-rondo-5-2.uitleg: Four players on the sides and one in the middle keep the ball against two defenders. A pass through the middle player counts double. If a defender wins the ball, they swap with the player who lost it.
veld-ps-rondo-5-2.organisatie: 12 × 12 m square. Four players on the sides, one middle player (team A) and two defenders inside the square.
coachpunten: Middle player: stay behind the defenders and ask for the ball between the lines
Only pass to the middle player when they are open; otherwise move the ball first
Defenders: cover the middle player first, then press

moeilijker: When the defenders win it, they score by dribbling the ball out of the square

veld-ps-rondo-5-2.meerSpelers: With more players: a second rondo, or 6v3 in a bigger square.

veld-ps-4-4-2-jokers.uitleg: Two teams of four play inside a square; two jokers on the lines always play for the team in possession (6v4). Six passes in a row is a point. When the ball is lost, the jokers immediately play for the other team.
veld-ps-4-4-2-jokers.organisatie: 20 × 20 m square. Jokers (purple) in the middle of two opposite lines. Teams in bibs inside the square.
benodigdheden: bibs in 2 colours + 2 for the jokers
coachpunten: Make the pitch big when you have the ball: get wide and deep
Use the jokers to switch the ball to the free side
Press straight away when you lose the ball (transition)

moeilijker: A pass from joker to joker counts double

veld-ps-4-4-2-jokers.meerSpelers: With 11 or 12 players: 5v5 with 2 jokers. With more: extra jokers on the touchline.

veld-ps-5-5-2-jokers.uitleg: Two teams of five with two jokers on the pitch (7v5 in possession). Ten passes in a row is a point. If the ball goes out, the coach immediately plays a new ball to the other team.
veld-ps-5-5-2-jokers.organisatie: 28 × 22 m area. Jokers (purple) in the middle of the area. The coach stands outside the line with a pile of balls.
benodigdheden: bibs in 2 colours + 2 for the jokers
coachpunten: Find the free player: who has no opponent close by?
Make triangles around the ball carrier
Counting out loud helps the team stay calm

makkelijker: Jokers can move freely and take unlimited touches
moeilijker: After ten passes, also score in a mini goal

veld-ps-5-5-2-jokers.meerSpelers: With more players: jokers on the touchline, or rotate in 3-minute blocks.

veld-ps-eindzone.uitleg: Two teams of four. You score by receiving the ball in the other team's end zone: a teammate runs in and receives it in the zone. Then the other team gets the ball and attacks the other way.
veld-ps-eindzone.organisatie: 20 × 22 m pitch with a 4 m deep end zone at each end. Teams in bibs. Players may only enter the zone once the ball is played into it.
coachpunten: Give depth: always someone on the last line who can run in
Timing: only make your run when the ball carrier can pass
Defenders: cover the space behind you, not just the ball carrier

makkelijker: Dribbling into the zone also counts
moeilijker: The ball must be controlled with one touch in the zone
4 passes first, then you can score

veld-ps-eindzone.meerSpelers: With 9 players: a joker. With more: 5v5 in a bigger area, or a second pitch.

veld-ps-omschakelen.uitleg: The red team plays a rondo in square 1 against two blue defenders; the other two blues wait in square 2. When blue wins the ball, they play it straight into square 2 and both defenders sprint over: blue keeps the ball there, and two red players have to get across and press as quickly as possible.
veld-ps-omschakelen.organisatie: Two 10 × 10 m squares with 6 m between them. Four players per team. Red starts with four players on the sides of square 1, blue with two defenders in square 1 and two waiting players in square 2.
coachpunten: After winning the ball: first pass straight to the other square, before the opponents recover
After losing the ball: switch straight away and sprint across with two players
In square 2, get wide and open first, then keep it calmly

makkelijker: One red player presses instead of two
moeilijker: The long ball must be played on first time
A point for red if they win the ball back within 5 seconds

veld-ps-omschakelen.meerSpelers: With more players: jokers on the touchlines, or 5v5 in bigger squares.

veld-ps-door-de-linies.naam: Through the lines: playing from zone to zone
veld-ps-door-de-linies.uitleg: The red team has three players in zone 1 and three in zone 3; blue defends with three players in the middle zone. Red tries to play the ball through or round the middle zone to the other side. One blue player may press in the zone with the ball. Every successful pass to the other side is a point.
veld-ps-door-de-linies.organisatie: 20 × 30 m pitch divided into three 10 m zones. Red: 3 + 3 in the outside zones, blue: 3 in the middle. Swap roles after 2 minutes.
coachpunten: Move the ball quickly from left to right to open a gap in the middle zone
Play through the gap as soon as it opens: don't wait too long
Blue: shift across as a unit and keep the distances between you small

makkelijker: A lofted ball over the middle zone is also allowed
No blue player in the outside zone
moeilijker: The pass to the other side must be played on first time

veld-ps-door-de-linies.meerSpelers: With more players: an extra player per zone, or a joker on the touchline.

veld-cv-rondo-uitbreken.naam: 4v1 rondo and break out to goal
veld-cv-rondo-uitbreken.uitleg: Four players keep the ball in a square against one defender. After a few passes, the player on the goal side sprints out of the square, receives a through ball and finishes on the big goal.
veld-cv-rondo-uitbreken.organisatie: 8 × 8 m square 26 m from goal, keeper in goal. After 3–5 passes, the front player may break out. Whoever makes a mistake goes in the middle.
coachpunten: Rondo: stay open and play in two touches
Breaking out: only go when the ball is on the right side, then go flat out
Through ball into the run, not to feet

moeilijker: The defender may chase the runner
Finish within 6 seconds of breaking out

veld-cv-rondo-uitbreken.meerSpelers: With more players: a second rondo next to it, and the rondos take turns to break out.

veld-ps-rondo-4-2-uitbraak.uitleg: A 4v2 rondo in a square in front of goal. After 8 passes without losing the ball, the striker is played in behind and finishes against the keeper. If the defenders win the ball, they can score in a mini goal behind the square.
veld-ps-rondo-4-2-uitbraak.organisatie: 10 × 10 m square about 28 m from goal, mini goal 4 m behind the square. The striker waits diagonally in front of the square, on the goal side. Full-size goal with keeper.
coachpunten: Rondo: stay open, ball along the ground, in one or two touches
Through ball into the striker's path, not to feet
Striker: time your run (not too early), finish into the corner

moeilijker: A defender may chase the striker

veld-ps-rondo-4-2-uitbraak.meerSpelers: With more players: two rondos side by side that take turns to play the striker in, or two strikers.

veld-ps-3-3-3-spits.naam: 3v3 + 3 possession and play into the striker
veld-ps-3-3-3-spits.uitleg: Three teams of three in a square. The team in possession plays with the neutral team (6v3) against the third team. After 6 passes the ball may go into the striker, who waits outside the square and finishes against the keeper. When a team loses the ball, the team that wins it becomes the team in possession.
veld-ps-3-3-3-spits.organisatie: 16 × 16 m square about 22 m from goal. Three teams of three in different bibs, striker between the square and the goal. Full-size goal with keeper.
coachpunten: Get wide and deep: make the square big
Look before the ball arrives: where is the free player, where is the striker?
Striker: keep moving and get free as the sixth pass is played
veld-ps-3-3-3-spits.meerSpelers: With more players: 4v4 + 4, or two strikers who take turns.
